text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِۦ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِى ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍۢ يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُۥٓ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ يُجَٰهِدُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَآئِمٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ

words.gloss_range: direct vocative opening of the warning
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:ya}}) opens 5:54 by turning the discourse into direct address. The believers hear the risk of defection and the promise of replacement as a communal warning spoken to them, not as detached narration about another group.

topics.headline: warning as direct address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is spoken to believers directly, so defection and replacement are not detached reports about someone else.
topics.reason: The vocative opens the ayah as second-person communal address and carries the preceding discourse into a direct warning.

words.gloss_range: vocative extender identifying the addressed class
words.prose: {{ar:أَيُّهَا}} ({{tr:ayyuha}}) extends the summons and singles out the addressed class before any exception appears. Its payoff is attentional: the warning is aimed at believers precisely as the ones being called to listen.

topics.headline: addressees singled out
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the vocative formula pauses over the addressed class before the risk of apostasy is named.
topics.reason: The vocative extender identifies the addressees as a class and demands attention to the following condition.

words.gloss_range: relative qualifier that makes believers the addressed group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhina}}) qualifies the vocative by belief-status. The apostasy condition that follows is therefore framed as an internal risk within the believing address, not as a statement about outsiders.

topics.headline: belief qualifies the summons
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the apostasy condition is introduced inside the believing addressee group, not outside it.
topics.reason: The relative qualifier binds the summons to those characterized by faith before any internal subset is considered.

words.gloss_range: completed faith-claim used as the addressee label, tested by the warning that follows
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, and security range; local form names professed belief while the security resonance remains secondary
words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:amanu}}) names the addressees by a completed faith-claim, while the ayah immediately tests whether that claim will endure. The root's security and trust range remains a resonance, but the local verb is the professed faith that can be ruptured by reversal.

topics.headline: completed faith under reversal risk
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tension between a completed faith-label and the possibility that such a claim can be reversed.
topics.reason: The perfect verb names an already claimed faith, while the following reversal clause keeps continuity under test; root security remains a resonance, not the local gloss.

words.gloss_range: open conditional pronoun introducing the possible defector
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) leaves the possible defector unnamed and opens the conditional architecture. The same small openness later reappears for the recipient of bounty, so the ayah moves from an unspecified possibility of loss to an unspecified possibility of gift.

topics.headline: unspecified conditional defector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the possible defector is left open, and the same openness later returns for the recipient of bounty.
topics.reason: The conditional pronoun starts the protasis and leaves identity unspecified, then is echoed by the later recipient pronoun.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII jussive reversal: turning oneself back from the claimed bond
words.root_gloss_range: return, reversal, and recoil range; local context selects religious/covenantal defection
words.prose: {{ar:يَرْتَدَّ}} ({{tr:yartadda}}) compresses the warning into a Form VIII self-reversal: someone may turn himself back from the bond he claimed. The broader return/recoil image survives, while the surrounding separation from religion narrows it to covenantal defection; the accepted surface variation keeps that recoil sense.

topics.headline: self-directed recoil from faith
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices apostasy as a compressed self-reversal from within the community, not merely a vague change of opinion.
topics.reason: Form VIII and the doubled root support reflexive recoil; accepted reading variation preserves the same reversal sense while local context narrows it to religious defection.

words.gloss_range: partitive second-person source: from among you
words.prose: {{ar:مِنكُمْ}} ({{tr:minkum}}) makes the danger partitive and second-person: from among you. The warning therefore audits the addressed community from within instead of projecting apostasy onto a distant other.

topics.headline: defection from among you
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the danger is internal to the addressed group, making the warning an audit of the community itself.
topics.reason: The partitive preposition with the second-person suffix marks possible defection as arising from among the addressees.

words.gloss_range: separation preposition governing the abandoned bond
words.prose: {{ar:عَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) gives the reversal a separation-vector. The movement is not generic backsliding only; it is away from the binding order named by the following possessed noun.

topics.headline: turning away from a bond
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reversal is given a direction: away from a specific binding order.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following noun and construes the act as separation rather than mere motion.

words.gloss_range: possessed singular religious bond under separation
words.root_gloss_range: religion, obligation, debt, and judgment range; local noun marks the person's binding religious claim
words.prose: {{ar:دِينِهِۦ}} ({{tr:dinihi}}) makes the abandoned bond personal: his religion, his obligation, his accountable claim. The root's debt/judgment field deepens the bond, while local grammar keeps religion as the selected sense and rejects the alternative root route.

topics.headline: his binding religious claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the abandoned object is personalized as the defector's own binding claim, with obligation and accountability behind the religious noun.
topics.reason: The singular suffix personalizes the noun, and the root field can add obligation and judgment while the local context selects religion; the alternative root is not adopted.

words.gloss_range: response connector binding defection to divine replacement
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) binds the condition to its answer. Human withdrawal is not allowed to read as the collapse of the divine project; it is immediately followed by divine replacement.

topics.headline: condition tied to replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human withdrawal is immediately bound to a divine response rather than left as communal collapse.
topics.reason: The response connector links the conditional protasis to the replacement apodosis.

words.gloss_range: future particle of deferred but certain response
words.prose: {{ar:سَوْفَ}} ({{tr:sawfa}}) stretches the response into a future horizon without weakening certainty. The replacement may unfold in time, but the grammar presents it as under divine control.

topics.headline: certain future response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a future horizon: the promised replacement may unfold over time but is stated with certainty.
topics.reason: The future particle marks a coming response under divine control, with the sound row adding forward movement after the recoil verb.

words.gloss_range: coming/bringing verb with supplied people through the following preposition
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and giving range; local construction selects God bringing a people
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِى}} ({{tr:yati}}) pictures God bringing a people into the moral scene through the following preposition. The root's arrival/coming range remains visible, and the later grant verb links this bringing to giving by the same root; 5:52 supplies a nearby contrast where God may bring victory rather than the community itself.

topics.headline: God brings a people into view
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that replacement is pictured as a divine act of bringing, linked later to divine giving by the same root.
topics.reason: The verb with the following preposition selects bringing, while the broader arrival/giving root field remains visible through the later grant verb and the echo with 5:52.

words.gloss_range: explicit divine subject of the replacement action
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; local function is explicit agency rather than etymological derivation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allahu}}) is the explicit subject of the replacement action. The name should not be reduced to etymology here: its local force is sovereign agency, resolving the failed-alliance scene by God's initiative and preparing the love and allegiance chain that follows in 5:55-56.

topics.headline: God as explicit replacement agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repair of communal failure is anchored in God's initiative, not in the warned group's self-stability.
topics.reason: The nominative divine name is the subject of the bringing verb; etymological reduction is avoided, while cross-references in 5:52 and 5:55-56 show the local agency within a wider divine-control chain.

words.gloss_range: instrumental/accompaniment preposition introducing the supplied people
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) introduces the replacement people as what God supplies with the act of bringing. The small preposition keeps the people attached to divine provision rather than appearing accidentally.

topics.headline: preposition introducing supplied community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are attached to the divine act as what God supplies.
topics.reason: The preposition after the bringing verb marks accompaniment or means and introduces the replacement group.

words.gloss_range: indefinite collective people specified by traits, not pedigree
words.root_gloss_range: standing, uprightness, and collective people range; local noun names an unnamed replacement community
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٍۢ}} ({{tr:qawmin}}) is an indefinite collective: an unnamed people, not a pre-labeled ethnicity. The standing/community root supports a functional body, and the following love, posture, striving, and fearlessness define them by ethical traits rather than pedigree.

topics.headline: unnamed collective defined by traits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the replacement is a collective left unnamed until love, posture, striving, and fearlessness define it.
topics.reason: The indefinite collective noun prevents ethnic fixing; the standing/community root is relevant as collective uprightness, while the following traits supply the identity.

words.gloss_range: God's love directed first toward the replacement people
words.root_gloss_range: love root with seed/grain resonance; local verb is transitive divine love
words.prose: {{ar:يُحِبُّهُمْ}} ({{tr:yuhibbuhum}}) states God's love first and directs it toward the replacement people. The seed/grain resonance of the root can color that love as generative, but the local verb remains transitive love that initiates the profile.

topics.headline: divine love initiates the profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the replacement people are first defined by God's love for them, with their later ethics growing from that relationship.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb places God's love first and directs it to the group; seed/grain resonance is kept as generative coloring, not a replacement for the love sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating link inside the reciprocal love pair
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the two love clauses into a reciprocal pair. It keeps God's love for them and their love for God coordinated as one defining relation.

topics.headline: love clauses bound together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine love and human love are coordinated as one reciprocal profile.
topics.reason: The conjunction binds the two love clauses so they function as a paired characterization.

words.gloss_range: collective return-love toward God with reversed pronouns
words.root_gloss_range: love root with generative resonance; local verb is the people's responsive love
words.prose: {{ar:يُحِبُّونَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:yuhibbunahu}}) reverses the love frame: the people collectively love God. Their response does not erase the asymmetry of origin, but it grounds the social posture and striving that follow in love rather than bare force.

topics.headline: collective love returned to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people's love is a collective response to God and becomes the ground for their public posture.
topics.reason: The same transitive love frame reverses subject and object, making reciprocity visible while preserving asymmetry in origin.

words.gloss_range: plural humility/lowliness directed toward believers
words.root_gloss_range: lowliness, pliancy, and abasement range; local target narrows it to willing humility, not disgrace
words.prose: {{ar:أَذِلَّةٍ}} ({{tr:adhillatin}}) gives the replacement people voluntary lowliness toward believers. Because the target is the faithful community and the next adjective supplies the opposite posture, the word means chosen humility here, not disgrace or defeat; 27:34 provides a contrast where the mighty are made low.

topics.headline: humility toward believers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lowliness revalued as voluntary humility because it is aimed toward believers and paired with firmness elsewhere.
topics.reason: The adjective's lowliness range is narrowed by its target and by the paired adjective; case variation keeps the role without changing the posture.

words.gloss_range: direction marker for humility toward believers
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ala}}) directs that humility toward a specific social target. The preposition itself is a relational axis; the humble adjective and the believers determine its gentle valence here.

topics.headline: direction for humble posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humility is not generalized self-abasement; it is directed toward believers.
topics.reason: The preposition marks relational direction and its value is supplied by the adjective and object, not by the preposition alone.

words.gloss_range: definite believers as the positive social target
words.root_gloss_range: faith, trust, and security range; local active participle names the recognized believers
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muminina}}) names the known believers as the target of humility. The opening faith-label returns as the group before whom the replacement people lower themselves, tying the warning back to the addressed community.

topics.headline: recognized believers as target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening believers reappear as the class toward whom the replacement people are humble.
topics.reason: The definite active participle names the recognized faith community and echoes the opening faith label.

words.gloss_range: plural might/firmness directed toward rejecters
words.root_gloss_range: might, resistance, preciousness, and inaccessibility range; local adjective selects principled firmness
words.prose: {{ar:أَعِزَّةٍ}} ({{tr:aizzatin}}) supplies the counter-posture: dignified firmness toward rejecters. The root's strength, rarity, and inaccessibility range is locally narrowed by the target, so the word signals principled resistance rather than uncontrolled severity.

topics.headline: firmness without uncontrolled harshness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same community must bear the opposite posture toward rejecters: dignified resistance, not a single temperament.
topics.reason: The strength/inaccessibility root field is narrowed by the target and by the parallel adjective slot; divine-attribute resonance remains a background of derivative might.

words.gloss_range: parallel direction marker for firmness against rejecters
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ala}}) repeats the same directional marker used with humility but now under the opposite adjective and object. The result is a balanced construction: one relational axis carries two ethically different directions.

topics.headline: same preposition, opposite valence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a balanced construction: one preposition carries two opposing social directions because the adjectives and targets change.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition supplies a stable relational axis while the paired adjectives and objects determine humility versus firmness.

words.gloss_range: definite rejecters as the opposing social target
words.root_gloss_range: covering/concealing and rejection range; local active participle names those characterized by rejection
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kafirina}}) identifies the opposing target as a definite rejection class. The covering/concealing root image supports moral rejection of truth, so firmness is aimed at that posture rather than at ethnicity or mere social otherness.

topics.headline: rejection, not ethnicity, as target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that firmness is aimed at a moral posture of rejection and concealment, matched against the believers.
topics.reason: The definite active participle names a rejection class; the covering root is relevant but locally functions as characterized disbelief, not ethnic othering.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form III striving without a named human object
words.root_gloss_range: exertion, capacity-spending, and striving range; local verb is God-oriented effort, not object-fixed combat
words.prose: {{ar:يُجَٰهِدُونَ}} ({{tr:yujahiduna}}) presents striving as an ongoing communal trait without naming a human object. The root's effort-and-capacity pressure and Form III engagement make this sustained exertion, while the following path phrase defines its direction before conflict can dominate the reading.

topics.headline: sustained effort before any human target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that striving is a continuing exertion in God's path, not reduced by the grammar to a named human enemy.
topics.reason: The imperfect plural makes it a trait, Form III and the root stress exertion, and the missing object keeps the act governed by the following path phrase.

words.gloss_range: domain preposition locating striving within God's path
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fi}}) locates the striving within a domain. The effort is bounded by God's path before the ayah adds fearlessness toward social blame.

topics.headline: striving located in a domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the effort is bounded by a divinely defined sphere before fearlessness is added.
topics.reason: The preposition locates the action inside the path phrase rather than attaching it to a personal object.

words.gloss_range: singular construct path owned by God
words.root_gloss_range: path, way, and open course range; local construct makes the domain God-owned
words.prose: {{ar:سَبِيلِ}} ({{tr:sabili}}) makes the domain a singular God-owned path. The open-road sense gives the effort direction and containment, while the recognized formula keeps striving oriented by God rather than by a self-selected agenda.

topics.headline: open path owned by God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that exertion is directed along one God-owned way, restraining effort by orientation before conflict can dominate interpretation.
topics.reason: The singular construct and wider formula make the path the domain of God-oriented effort; the open-road image remains a concrete support, not a separate route claim.

words.gloss_range: divine possessor of the striving path
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; local genitive marks ownership/source of the path
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allahi}}) completes the construct: the path belongs to God. The same divine name that brought the people now defines the way in which they strive, part of the ayah's repeated God-centered chain.

topics.headline: God owns the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the one who brings the people also owns the path in which they strive.
topics.reason: The genitive divine name completes the construct and threads the divine name through replacement, path, bounty, and closure.

words.gloss_range: coordinator linking striving with fearlessness
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates positive action with negated social fear. The replacement people are characterized both by striving in God's path and by refusing the leverage of blame.

topics.headline: striving paired with fearlessness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the community is defined both by what it actively does and by the social pressure it refuses.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the striving clause with the negated fear clause as paired traits.

words.gloss_range: negation of the fear clause, specifically social blame
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}) negates the fear clause as a continuing trait. Because the object is blame, the negation is about human censure's authority, not the absence of reverent fear of God.

topics.headline: negation of blame's authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation targets social blame's authority, not reverent fear of God.
topics.reason: The negation with the imperfect marks an ongoing trait and is narrowed by the blame object that follows.

words.gloss_range: negated fear as a stable communal trait
words.root_gloss_range: fear and pressure range; local negation denies control by social censure, not all reverent fear
words.prose: {{ar:يَخَافُونَ}} ({{tr:yakhafuna}}) keeps fear intelligible as pressure but denies it governing power over the people. The object is blame itself, and 5:23 and 5:28 sharpen the contrast: there fear is rightly directed toward God, while here human blame is not feared.

topics.headline: fear denied governing power
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that fear remains a real social pressure, but the replacement people do not let blame govern them; 5:23 and 5:28 contrast fear rightly ordered toward God.
topics.reason: The verb is negated and takes blame as object, so the local clause denies control by human censure while inter-ayah echoes in 5:23 and 5:28 distinguish courage from lack of reverence.

words.gloss_range: single act of blame as the feared object, then refused
words.root_gloss_range: blame and reproach range; local instant-noun compresses even one reproach into the object of fearlessness
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْمَةَ}} ({{tr:lawmata}}) compresses the pressure to a single act of reproach, then makes even that powerless. The phrase distinguishes external blame from the self-reproaching soul of 75:2, and the event-agent echo with the next word makes social censure a tight unit that is overruled.

topics.headline: even one reproach cannot deter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the feared pressure is compressed to even one act of reproach, then denied power over the people.
topics.reason: The instant-noun form and construct with the active blamer make external blame concrete; 75:2 supplies contrast with internal self-reproach, not the local object.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active blamer as generic social-pressure agent
words.root_gloss_range: blame/reproach range; local participle names any person who enacts blame
words.prose: {{ar:لَآئِمٍۢ}} ({{tr:laimin}}) names any blamer, not one special opponent. The indefinite active participle turns social pressure into a generic actor whose leverage has been removed, and the repeated blame root intensifies the immunity.

topics.headline: generic blamer loses leverage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase names both blame and any social actor who produces it, making public courage resistant to reputational leverage.
topics.reason: The indefinite active participle generalizes the blamer, and the root echo with the blame event intensifies immunity from social pressure.

words.gloss_range: retrospective demonstrative gathering the whole trait profile
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhalika}}) gathers the whole portrait just described: love, humility, firmness, striving, and fearlessness. The demonstrative then pivots from traits to source, preventing the profile from being read as self-produced merit.

topics.headline: that gathers the whole portrait
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that love, posture, striving, and fearlessness are gathered and then reclassified as divine bounty.
topics.reason: The demonstrative points back to the integrated profile and pivots the ayah from description to theological attribution.

words.gloss_range: bounty/surplus reclassifying the profile as divine gift
words.root_gloss_range: surplus, bounty, favor, and excess range; local construct makes the profile grace rather than earned merit
words.prose: {{ar:فَضْلُ}} ({{tr:fadlu}}) reclassifies the entire replacement profile as divine bounty. Its surplus/favor range makes the traits a gift rather than compensation earned by the community, and the formula resonates with selective bounty in 2:90 and 3:73.

topics.headline: surplus bounty source statement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole ethical profile is not self-produced merit but surplus bounty from God, echoing the selective bounty formula in 2:90 and 3:73.
topics.reason: The noun names bounty/surplus in a compact source statement; formula echoes in 2:90 and 3:73 support discretionary generosity without replacing the local profile.

words.gloss_range: divine source/owner of the bounty
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; local genitive marks the bounty as God's
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allahi}}) marks the bounty as God's own. The construct keeps the source statement compact and links the God-owned path of effort with the God-owned bounty behind the profile.

topics.headline: God as bounty source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same divine name owns both the path of effort and the bounty behind the profile.
topics.reason: The genitive construct marks the bounty as divine property/source and keeps the source statement compact.

words.gloss_range: Form IV granting verb with pronoun referring to bounty
words.root_gloss_range: coming/bringing/giving range; local Form IV selects active bestowal
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْتِيهِ}} ({{tr:yutihi}}) turns the named bounty into something actively granted. Its object pronoun points back to the bounty noun, while the Form IV giving verb echoes the earlier bringing verb; 3:73 and 2:247 share the same grant-to-whomever-He-wills formula followed by the same attribute pair.

topics.headline: bounty actively bestowed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bounty is something God actively grants, with the earlier bringing of a people and this giving linked by the same root; 3:73 and 2:247 share the formula.
topics.reason: The object pronoun points back to bounty, Form IV selects bestowal, and the root echo links bringing and giving while formula parallels in 3:73 and 2:247 confirm the closure pattern.

words.gloss_range: relative recipient pronoun enclosed by giving and willing
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) is the recipient pronoun, not a new apostasy condition. It echoes the earlier open pronoun but changes the direction from possible loss to possible grace, enclosed between divine giving and divine willing.

topics.headline: recipient rather than new condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second open pronoun is not another defection condition but the unspecified recipient of grace.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is enclosed between divine giving and willing, echoing the earlier conditional pronoun while changing the direction from loss to gift.

words.gloss_range: divine willing as ongoing specification of the recipient
words.root_gloss_range: will and thing/specification range; local clause assigns distribution to divine will
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashau}}) closes the giving clause with divine will. The root's will/specification field makes distribution more than vague preference: the bounty is assigned by God's ongoing will, so recognizable virtue is theologically decentered.

topics.headline: will specifies the gift recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that virtue remains recognizable but its distribution is decentered under God's ongoing will.
topics.reason: The imperfect will clause closes the grant statement and blocks entitlement; the root's thing/specification field is kept as effective specification, not vague preference.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening the final attribute sentence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final attribute sentence. It separates the closing predication from the prior grant clause and explains why such giving belongs to God.

topics.headline: resumptive opening to attributes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens a final theological coda to ground the grant just named.
topics.reason: The resumptive coordinator starts a new attribute sentence rather than merely extending the previous chain.

words.gloss_range: divine subject of the closing attribute pair
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine name; local nominative anchors the final predicates
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allahu}}) anchors the final predicates. The ayah turns from the human replacement profile back to God as the one whose capacity and knowledge ground the promise.

topics.headline: God anchors final predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closure turning from the human replacement profile back to God as the subject of capacity and knowledge.
topics.reason: The nominative divine name functions as subject of the two final predicates and keeps the ayah explicitly God-centered.

words.gloss_range: vastness/capacity predicate grounding non-scarce bounty
words.root_gloss_range: capacity, breadth, containment, and expansiveness range; local predicate grounds divine giving beyond scarcity
words.prose: {{ar:وَٰسِعٌ}} ({{tr:wasiun}}) gives the first closing predicate: vast capacity before knowledge. The bounty is not scarce or threatened by communal loss, and the attribute pair appears elsewhere in 2:115, 2:247, 2:261, and 3:73.

topics.headline: vast capacity before knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that replacement and bounty are grounded first in divine vastness, so communal loss does not make the promise scarce; 2:115, 2:247, 2:261, and 3:73 share the attribute pair.
topics.reason: The active participle predicate presents enduring capacity and comes before knowledge, expanding the scope of giving before the paired predicate secures it.

words.gloss_range: intensive knowledge predicate closing the ayah
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge range; local intensive adjective makes the expansive giving informed and exact
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌ}} ({{tr:alimun}}) closes the ayah with intensive knowledge. Expansive giving is therefore not indiscriminate: God knows whom to replace, whom to love, and to whom the bounty is granted.

topics.headline: knowledge governs expansive giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends not on human striving but on divine knowledge governing whom God replaces, loves, and grants.
topics.reason: The second predicate is coordinated with vastness and the intensive form makes expansive giving exact rather than indiscriminate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَن يَرْتَدَّ مِنكُمْ عَن دِينِهِ فَسَوْفَ يَأْتِي اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: Withdrawal from the binding order is answered by divine countermovement: another collective arrives, rises to the task, and can stand in the vacated place. The community's function is therefore not hostage to its present bearers.

activation_trace.role: Return to a former position supplies the deserter's backward motion and opens a vacancy in the present body.
Religious reversion fixes that backward motion specifically at the focus construction rather than at generic indecision.
Coming and reaching, foregrounded at index 10, supplies the divine countermovement that answers retreat.
Standing in another's place turns the arriving people from a demographic label into a functional successor.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely threatens an apostate with a different people.
changed_reading.after: The ayah declares covenantal work replaceable: retreat creates no institutional veto because God can install a body that stands in and carries it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Reciprocal attachment is the center of a two-direction social posture: secure softness toward those who trust and resistant strength toward those who cover or oppose. The adjectives describe relational calibration, not one flat temperament.

activation_trace.role: Love lodged in and cleaving to the heart supplies the reciprocal bond from which both social postures proceed.
A yielding side without degradation makes inward gentleness compatible with dignity rather than servility.
Strength that reverses lowliness supplies the resistant face of the same loved collective.
Heart-security and trust explain why gentleness among believers need not be anxious self-abasement.

changed_reading.before: The people combine kindness to insiders with toughness toward outsiders.
changed_reading.after: Mutual divine love generates a secure relational polarity: voluntarily yielding within trust, structurally unyielding where truth is covered or resisted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُجَاهِدُونَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَلَا يَخَافُونَ لَوْمَةَ لَائِمٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The people spend capacity under difficulty along a traversable God-oriented way. Their continuity depends on withstanding anticipated social correction: blame does not redirect or halt the path-work.

activation_trace.role: Expenditure of one's available capacity under strain supplies the cost and persistence of the work.
An extended route that can be traveled gives exertion a direction and prevents effort from becoming self-justifying.
Anticipation of harm names the pressure that the negation removes from human censure.
Reproach for alleged fault supplies the social enforcement mechanism that cannot turn them off the route.

changed_reading.before: They fight bravely and ignore criticism.
changed_reading.after: They persistently spend capacity on God's route while refusing to let reputational discipline determine that route.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذَلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللَّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The successor body and its capacities are framed as an unowed gift, intentionally allotted from divine expanse with full knowledge. The close blocks the group from construing its strength as self-made superiority.

activation_trace.role: A benefaction beyond obligation casts the whole preceding profile as gift rather than earned entitlement.
Giving, foregrounded at index 32, supplies the transfer by which the profile is conferred.
Will directed to a thing makes the allotment intentional rather than automatic or hereditary.
Expanse opposed to constriction removes scarcity from divine replacement and giving.
Full cognitive disclosure supplies the discriminating knowledge governing whom the gift reaches.

changed_reading.before: The listed virtues earn a divine reward called فضل.
changed_reading.after: The people, their relational balance, and their durable effort are themselves a knowingly allotted surplus gift, excluding hereditary or moral self-ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier brother refuses to mirror a killing hand because he fears God. This revises the focus negation from generic fearlessness to a hierarchy of fear: reverent fear can block violence while fear of a blamer cannot compel betrayal.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm is negated only when its source is the human blamer.
Costly exertion is the activity whose moral direction must be governed by the reordered fear.
Anticipated harm before God supplies a positively retained fear that restrains retaliation.
Taking life supplies the mirrored action explicitly refused under that retained fear.

structural_cues: 5:28 places 'I fear God' inside a refusal to answer an extended killing hand with killing; 5:54 negates fear specifically of a blamer.
The focus pairs non-fear with directed exertion rather than presenting it as an isolated temperament.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one positive and one negated fear plus the refusal/exertion constructions; I infer a ranking that redirects courage, while the live alternative is that the two fear statements address unrelated situations.

changed_reading.before: The replacement people are simply fearless.
changed_reading.after: They are fear-disciplined: awe of God can restrain them, but threatened reputation cannot govern their action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first exact context occurrence of striving on God's path sits in a sequence of self-guarding, seeking an approach, exertion, and hoped-for flourishing. That sequence gives the focus striving a relational destination and a life-producing horizon.

activation_trace.role: Costly use of capacity is the focus action clarified by the earlier sequence.
A traversable route is the focus direction whose entry and outcome the sequence supplies.
Placing oneself behind protection supplies a guarding condition before exertion.
Active seeking supplies approach and desire before strenuous movement.
Expenditure under strain repeats the focus action and binds the two ayat functionally.
The extended traveled route repeats the focus direction rather than leaving exertion unbounded.
Enduring success supplies the hoped-for terminus of guarding, approach, and exertion.

structural_cues: 5:35 orders guarding, seeking the branchless الوسيلة cue, striving on the path, and hoped-for flourishing.
5:54 repeats the same ج ه د plus س ب ل construction after reciprocal love.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered verbs and exact root repetition; I infer that sequence as the directional grammar of focus striving, while a live alternative treats each command in 5:35 as coordinate rather than causal.

changed_reading.before: Striving in God's path is an independent display of force.
changed_reading.after: It is guarded, approach-seeking labor on a traversable way whose horizon is enduring flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: All earthly value doubled cannot purchase acceptance, while dominion, willing, and effective capacity remain God's. The focus gift is therefore not a commodity by which an incumbent body can secure irreplaceability.

activation_trace.role: Unowed benefaction names the focus allocation whose non-market character is sharpened.
Substituting one valuable thing to redeem another supplies the failed purchase mechanism.
Reception with approval supplies the outcome that total wealth cannot buy.
Sovereign dominion locates control of allocation outside incumbent possession.
Will directed toward its object supplies intentional discrimination in punishment, covering, and every thing.
Effective ability reaching action supplies the power to execute the sovereign choice.

structural_cues: 5:36 makes even the whole earth plus its like fail as ransom for acceptance.
5:40 joins God's dominion, repeated willing, and capacity; 5:54 echoes willing in the sentence of gift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed ransom and sovereign willing/capacity; I infer that the focus qualification cannot be purchased or monopolized, while the live alternative limits 5:36 and 5:40 to judgment without bearing on communal replacement.

changed_reading.before: فضل is a reward attached after the group's virtues.
changed_reading.after: The group's very capacity is an unbuyable allocation that no wealth, incumbency, or inherited status can lock down.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearest earlier declaration of whom God loves names people who maintain equity in adjudication, even when deciding whether to engage hostile petitioners. Reciprocal love in the focus thus carries a public distributive and judicial practice.

activation_trace.role: Heart-fast mutual attachment is the focus bond given an ethical operation by the context.
Judgment between people supplies the contested public setting in which love is disclosed.
Equity and giving each side its due supply the conduct explicitly attached to divine love.
The same heart-binding love root directly links equitable actors to the reciprocal-love profile.

structural_cues: 5:42 closes its adjudication instruction with God's love for the equitable.
5:54 makes God's love and the people's answering love the first positive marks of the successor body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated love root and its equitable object; I infer equity as one concrete enactment of reciprocal love, while the live alternative leaves the two love statements related only at a general moral level.

changed_reading.before: God's love identifies a favored, emotionally devout group.
changed_reading.after: The love relation is publicly testable as equity, including fairness toward parties outside the group's intimacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Entrusted guardians are witnesses who must fear God rather than people and refuse to exchange signs for a small price. The focus immunity to blame is therefore custodial independence from social and economic capture, not mere contrarianism.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm from censure is the pressure whose authority the focus removes.
Reproach supplies the reputational sanction against which custodial independence is required.
Guarding and attentive preservation supply the office for which courage is needed.
Present observation supplies accountable witness rather than private possession of the trust.
Fear joined with awe is explicitly redirected from people to God, supplying the governing hierarchy.
Exchange by sale supplies the economic capture that the guardians must refuse.

structural_cues: 5:44 sequences entrusted preservation, witness, 'do not fear people but fear Me,' and refusal of a cheap exchange.
5:54 replaces fear of people with the narrower social instrument of a blamer's reproach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the custodial sequence and parallel fear contrast; I infer that blame-resistance protects entrusted truth from capture, while the live alternative reads 5:54 as courage without a specific custodial office.

changed_reading.before: Not fearing blame is a heroic personality trait.
changed_reading.after: It is institutional integrity: witnesses resist reputation and price so that an entrusted norm remains guarded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Assigned access and a clear road are followed by testing rather than forced sameness and by competition toward beneficial goods. This makes the focus path a field of faithful performance whose proof is forward good, not erasure of every differentiated route.

activation_trace.role: A route open to traversal is the focus image expanded by the context's differentiated access and clear roadway.
A visible water-access point supplies a distinct assigned entry to sustaining direction.
A plainly marked road supplies legibility within differentiated assignment.
Testing that exposes actual condition converts received difference into accountable performance.
Advancing in a race supplies the positive motion requested under the test.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the race's object and criterion.

structural_cues: 5:48 states differentiated شرعة and منهاج, says one community could have been made, identifies testing in what was given, and commands racing in goods.
The return of all parties to God follows the race, leaving final disclosure with God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated assignment, unrealized forced unity, test, and race; I infer these as constraints on the focus path, while the live alternative limits plurality to prior communities and treats 5:54's path as singularly uniform.

changed_reading.before: Striving in God's path tends toward making all routes socially identical.
changed_reading.after: The path proves fidelity amid assigned difference through tested movement toward good, with final resolution returned to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated turning away from judgment culminates in the warning that taking a rival protection network makes one 'of them.' The focus retreat can therefore be enacted as a transfer of operative proximity, aid, and belonging, not only as an inward proposition.

activation_trace.role: Backward return supplies the focus motion whose social mechanism the context exposes.
Turning one's back supplies an enacted departure after seeking judgment.
A second act of turning away makes departure recurrent rather than merely conceptual.
Adopting something as one's own supplies the deliberate formation of a rival tie.
Love, aid, and protective alliance supply the operative proximity by which the person becomes counted with the other network.

structural_cues: 5:43 and 5:49 repeat turning away after or from judgment.
5:51 places chosen protectors, reciprocal internal protection, and 'he is of them' immediately before the focus warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated turning and an allegiance-to-belonging construction; I infer relational transfer as one mechanism of focus retreat, while the live alternative restricts ارتداد to an explicit formal renunciation.

changed_reading.before: Apostasy is only a private reversal of belief.
changed_reading.after: It can appear as a lived reassignment of proximity, protection, and belonging that displaces the community's governing tie.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inner debility produces rapid movement into protective networks because an adverse turn is feared; divine arrival and opening then expose concealed calculation. The loved successor body is the opposite political psychology: secure enough not to let forecast loss accelerate its allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Heart-security supplies the stable interior that contrasts with fear-driven acceleration.
Divine coming, foregrounded at index 10, answers the earlier hoped-for arrival and carries the replacement response.
Debility that weakens movement supplies the compromised inner condition paradoxically driving reactive motion.
Speed opposed to deliberation supplies the visible behavior produced by insecurity.
Fear with apprehensive weight supplies the stated motive for hurried affiliation.
A feared adverse cycle or defeat supplies the projected loss around which allegiance is calculated.
God's bringing of an event supplies the countermovement outside the calculators' control.
An opening into prevailing success supplies one possible event that reverses the fear calculation.
Hidden inward content supplies the concealed motive that the reversal makes publicly regrettable.

structural_cues: 5:52 gives the chain inner sickness, rushing among them, fear of a reversal, divine bringing, and regret over what was concealed.
5:54 repeats divine bringing but makes secure reciprocal love and non-fear the replacement profile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the causal speech of fear, speed, projected reversal, and divine arrival; I infer the successor people as an alternative allegiance psychology, while the live alternative treats their arrival as unrelated to the prior actors' haste.

changed_reading.before: God replaces doctrinal defectors with more courageous believers.
changed_reading.after: God replaces fear-priced allegiance with a secure body whose attachment does not accelerate toward whichever coalition seems safest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah uses maximal effort to intensify sworn speech, then declares the swearers' works collapsed; the focus turns the same effort root into sustained action. The adjacency distinguishes strenuous performance of loyalty from loyalty embodied under strain.

activation_trace.role: Capacity spent under hardship becomes an ongoing verb of embodied path-work in the focus.
A formally apportioned oath supplies the speech act that claims loyalty.
Maximum expenditure intensifies the oath verbally, creating the lexical pivot into embodied exertion.
The binding oath supplies the vehicle whose intensity proves insufficient.
Falling and sinking supplies the failure of the swearers' practical record.
Intentional deed supplies the missing test against which strenuous speech is exposed.

structural_cues: 5:53 places جهد inside 'their strongest oaths,' then says their works collapsed.
5:54 immediately recasts the same root as a continuing plural verb on God's path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, exact root repetition, oath, and failed work; I infer a deliberate speech-to-deed correction, while the live alternative treats جهد in the two constructions as ordinary lexical reuse without contrast.

changed_reading.before: Jihad is chiefly maximal intensity or vehement declaration.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts oath-maximalism with durable work: real exertion survives as action on the path when reputational speech collapses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus gentleness toward believers is immediately rendered as a pattern of allegiance, maintaining prayer, transferring purifying increase, and bending low. Its lowliness is therefore voluntary worship and material service within trust, not loss of agency.

activation_trace.role: Yielding without humiliation supplies the focus posture concretized by the following practices.
Love, aid, and protective alliance supply the relational frame for the practices.
Standing over something through maintenance and care supplies the durable establishment of prayer.
Binding worship supplies the repeated communal practice maintained under allegiance.
Giving supplies outward transfer rather than inward sentiment alone.
Purification and soundness supply the ethical quality of the transferred due.
Bending as humility supplies a bodily enactment of willing lowliness.

structural_cues: 5:55 follows the focus with exclusive allegiance and relative clauses of maintaining prayer, giving zakat, and bowing.
The sequence combines vertical humility with horizontal transfer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and practices of maintenance, giving, and bending; I infer them as enactments of focus gentleness, while the live alternative treats 5:55 as an independent definition of allegiance rather than an expansion of أذلة.

changed_reading.before: Gentleness toward believers is an affective softness.
changed_reading.after: It is practiced lowliness: maintaining worship, bending before God, and releasing purifying value within the allied body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arriving people are followed by a party constituted through allegiance to God, the messenger, and believers, and characterized by prevailing. This favors a functional coalition identity over ethnicity and ties outward strength to alignment rather than autonomous power.

activation_trace.role: A body standing in another's place supplies the successor collective whose basis is clarified.
Strength after lowliness supplies the focus capacity linked to eventual prevailing.
Love, aid, and protective affiliation supply the act that forms the party.
A group cohering around a position supplies a functional rather than genealogical collective.
Power that overcomes supplies the outcome attached to aligned collective strength.

structural_cues: 5:56 conditionally forms God's party through taking God, the messenger, and believers as protectors.
Its prevailing conclusion follows the focus description of an arriving strong people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an allegiance condition, party label, and prevailing result; I infer this as the social formation of the focus people, while the live alternative treats حزب الله as a broader category only partially overlapping the promised قوم.

changed_reading.before: The replacement قوم is a preexisting ethnic or named population.
changed_reading.after: It can be read as a coalition formed by governing allegiance, with strength derivative of that alignment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates hydrological and outsider senses of the coming root, not the ordinary verbal gloss. It remains anchored in God's bringing of a قوم and that body's standing-in function. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy of replenishment from beyond incumbent boundaries, never as a demographic prediction.

activation_trace.role: A flood arriving from another land images fresh capacity entering where it was not locally generated.
A stranger entering a people supplies the social image of succession crossing an incumbent boundary.
Standing in another's place keeps the outsider image attached to functional replacement.

changed_reading.before: Replacement comes from a merely unspecified alternate group.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory spatial image, replacement capacity can flow in from beyond the current body's social horizon and take up its abandoned work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus surface plainly denotes blame, while a secondary branch of the same root concerns waiting and delay. It remains valid as a resonance beside continuing exertion. Downstream prose should retain the ordinary blame sense and add only that censure fails to induce temporal stalling.

activation_trace.role: Tarrying before action supplies a secondary temporal effect that hostile reproach fails to produce.
Sustained expenditure under difficulty supplies the motion that does not stall.
Rising with resolve supplies prompt undertaking of the vacated task.

changed_reading.before: They are emotionally unaffected by criticism.
changed_reading.after: Criticism neither governs them nor buys delay; the replacement body rises and continues difficult work.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it composes seed, yield, ear, and surplus branches from several focus roots. Every element is focus-anchored and coheres as a succession mechanism, but downstream prose should mark it as a regenerative material analogy rather than lexical paraphrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُحِبُّهُمْ وَيُحِبُّونَهُ ... فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ... ذَلِكَ فَضْلُ اللَّهِ

activation_trace.role: A seed that germinates supplies reciprocal love as the reproductive kernel of the successor body.
Emerging yield supplies the arrival of new communal capacity from the planted bond.
An extended grain-ear supplies a material bridge between path-shaped growth and fruit-bearing effort.
Increase and remainder supply regenerative surplus beyond replacement at bare parity.

changed_reading.before: God swaps one fixed group for another fixed group with better traits.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, reciprocal love seeds a self-renewing ecology whose path-work bears surplus capacity beyond what defection removed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the opposed social adjectives through material branches of tractability, a blow-receiving stake, compact ground, and exposed hard terrain. The adjectives and exertion root keep it anchored, but downstream prose should use it only as an engineering-like analogy for differentiated load-bearing, not as a literal social ontology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَذِلَّةٍ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَعِزَّةٍ عَلَى الْكَافِرِينَ يُجَاهِدُونَ

activation_trace.role: Making a difficult thing tractable supplies low-friction coordination within the believing body.
A stake that receives repeated blows supplies inward willingness to absorb load without transmitting rupture.
Compacted ground supplies a resistant outer boundary that does not yield under pressure.
Hard exposed terrain supplies the difficult surface across which the differentiated body must work.

changed_reading.before: Softness and strength are two personality settings.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the body lowers internal friction, absorbs internal load, and presents a compact boundary while traversing hard work.

strongest_changes: Fear is reordered, not erased: awe of God can restrain violence while fear of people, fortune, and blame cannot price allegiance.
The adjacent جهد pivot distinguishes maximal oath-performance from durable embodied work on God's path.
Reciprocal love becomes publicly legible as equity, custodial integrity, prayer, bowing, and redistributive giving.
Retreat and replacement become movements of operative allegiance and functional succession rather than only private belief and demographic substitution.
The path is bounded by guarding, approach, testing, differentiated assignment, and competition in beneficial good.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's strongest activation came from exact repeated roots and immediate reversals: fear of God versus fear of blame, divine love of the equitable versus reciprocal love, turning and alliance before ارتداد, oath-جهد plus collapsed work before يجاهدون, and hurried fear before God's repeated act of bringing.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the promised قوم denotes one concrete incoming population, any recurrent functional successor, or both.
How fully the immediate ولاية sequence defines ارتداد rather than illustrating one social mechanism of it.
How far 5:48's differentiated routes constrain the singular سبيل الله in the focus.
The outsider-flow, non-stalling, regenerative, and material-interface models remain analogical activations and should not displace ordinary lexical readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Love coordinates yielding and firmness.** `ح ب ب B002` is clinging attachment, `ذ ل ل B002` gentle yielding without humiliation, and `ع ز ز B004` reinforcing strength. The opposed relational postures share one loved community. I infer that attachment makes softness inwardly safe and outward firmness non-fragile.
2. **Spacious bounty replaces retreat without scarcity.** `ر د د B005` is reversion, `ف ض ل B003` bounty, and `و س ع B002` capacity to contain. I infer that apostasy does not deplete the project; expansive divine capacity brings another bearer, correcting a scarcity reading of communal loss.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Retreat triggers replacement rather than vacancy.** Fixed **ر د د / B005** (“apostasy or reversion from religion”) supplies backward motion, while the future “God will bring a people” answers it with incoming agency. 5:53 showed works collapsing under divided allegiance; 5:55–5:56 immediately identify the alternative center and its party. I infer that the communal function abandoned by retreating agents remains required and is reassigned. Apostasy therefore reads not only as individual loss but as a vacancy-producing act met by replacement.
2. **Reciprocal love is the cohesion that supports differentiated posture.** Twice-fixed **ح ب ب / B002** (“love as clinging attachment”) binds God and the coming people in both directions. The ayah then makes them yielding toward believers, strong toward rejecters, and resistant to blame. I infer that secure attachment permits softness internally without loss of external firmness. Their traits read as effects of relational cohesion rather than a list of unrelated virtues.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:55–5:56 made replacement concrete as a new alignment and party, confirming that retreat vacates functions that are immediately reassigned.

baseline.text: Ey inananlar! Sizden kim dininden dönerse Allah, kendisinin sevdiği, kendisini seven, inananlara karşı alçak gönüllü, inkâr edenlere karşı güçlü bir topluluk getirir. Onlar Allah yolunda çaba gösterir ve kınayanın kınamasından korkmazlar. Bu Allah'ın lütfudur, onu dilediğine verir. Allah'ın lütfu geniştir, o bilendir.

findings.text: Allah ile karşılıklı sevgi, inananlara karşı yumuşaklık ile inkârcılara karşı sağlamlığı uyumlu hale getirir.
Dinden geri çekilme boşluk bırakmaz; Allah'ın geniş lütfu yeni bir topluluğu ortaya çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الأمن ضد الخوف، والأمان وإعطاء الأمنة، والأمانة ضد الخيانة وما اؤتمن عليه، والآمن والمأمن والاستئمان، والأمين والمأمون وما يوثق به، ومنه وثاقة الناقة الأمون.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأمن ضد الخوف (ayn;sihah)؛ أصل الأمن طمأنينة النفس وزوال الخوف (mufradat)؛ الأمانة ضد الخيانة ومعناها سكون القلب (maqayis)؛ الأمان إعطاء الأمنة (maqayis;ayn)؛ أمن فلان يأمن أمنا وأمانا وأمنة فهو آمن (tahdhib)؛ استأمن إليه دخل في أمانه (sihah)؛ مأمنه منزله الذي فيه أمنه (mufradat)؛ الأمون الناقة الأمينة الوثيقة أو التي يؤمن فتورها وعثورها (ayn;sihah;mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، وتصديق الخبر أو الوعد، والإيمان على سبيل الشريعة أو إذعان النفس للحق حيث نصت المصادر، واستعمال مؤمن بمعنى مصدق الوعد.
يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.

root_profile.summary: Bu kok ailesi guven ve korkusuzluk, dogru sayip kabul etme ve duada kabul istegi sozu olmak uzere birbirine tarihsel olarak yakin ama islevce ayrilan uc ana alanda duzenlenir. Ortak bag kalbin yatismasi ve kabul duygusudur, fakat her dalin siniri guvenlik, tasdik ve dua formulu olarak ayri tutulmalidir.
